C1_frozen_var.fit: weighted ridge lag-one VAR on all pre-test transitions; coefficients frozen
C1_frozen_var.parameters: full 103x103 A and 103 intercepts per session
C1_frozen_var.stability: spectral radius capped at 0.995 by uniform scaling

C2_rolling_var.fit: equal-weight ridge on transitions with target <= landmark
C2_rolling_var.stability: same spectral cap at every refit

C3_ewma_var.fit: exponentially weighted ridge on all transitions <= landmark; half-life fixed
C3_ewma_var.stability: same spectral cap at every refit

C4_local_latent.reason: Stage A found no stable train-only latent orientation; adding a local latent encoder would mix incompatible coordinate systems and is not justified before C1-C3 are resolved.
